items.label: King's Cross St. Pancras Underground Station

notes: 16 stations in the Brixton to Walthamstow Central order shown. Each name is written on the page as "<name> Underground Station"; keys are the name alone so a result with or without the suffix matches. "Victoria" is a short key: it also matches anything mentioning the Victoria line, but no other station name contains it. King's Cross is keyed as "King's Cross" (page text: King's Cross St. Pancras, straight apostrophe) to allow "St Pancras" without the dot.
